{{2019–20 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2019–20 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Memphis]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was the 99th season of Tiger basketball, the second under head coach [[Penny Hardaway]], and the seventh as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They played their home games at the [[FedEx Forum]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Tigers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 22–14, 11–7 in [[2018–19 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2018–19 Tulane Green Wave men's basketball team|Tulane]] and [[2018-19 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]] in the [[2019 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] before losing to [[2018–19 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the semifinals. In the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|2019]] [[National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] Tournament, they defeated [[2018–19 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team|San Diego]] in the first round before losing to [[2018–19 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the second round.
